status_note: Proposed by M166 (A3); Jasper reacts on the M166 card ('Keep as proposed' or 'Edit'). Half C may override the route rule only with a written reason.

positions_minimap.note: World units; 350 is about one brush width. PARTIAL ships as dashed and coarse. Detection rate and longest gap are read with death gaps removed (a gap that starts within 3 s of that champion's CHAMPION_KILL).

positions_topdown.note: Bar hit rate: champion health bars found per top-down frame over 10.

wards.note: Per team (blue = creatorId 1-5, red = 6-10); the enemy team is counted separately. With fewer than 5 marked rows the same share (4/5) applies.

recalls.note: Precision: detected recalls confirmed by a purchase within 15 s. Recall: purchase bursts (outside the first 60 s and not within 120 s after that champion's death) matched by a detected recall within 15 s.

route_rule: A GO and B GO: A+B (B the primary source where recorded, A for full-game continuity).
B GO but recording real time only, A GO or PARTIAL: A+B with B on key windows.
A GO without B, or B not reached: A-only.
Neither GO: no-go (the board stays on tier 0+1; Scout is retired on evidence).
Half C may override the rule only with a written reason.
